📖 How to use

  1. Pick your bet size (1–25 credits).
  2. Press SPIN and watch the reels.
  3. Three of a kind pays up to 50×!
  4. Two of a kind returns your bet.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the reels weighted fairly?

Each symbol has a real weight — 7️⃣ is rarest, 🍒 most common — so payouts reflect true odds.

What are the payouts?

Three of a kind pays 2×–50× your bet; any two matching symbols returns your bet.

How many credits do I start with?

You start with 100 credits and can bet 1, 5, 10, or 25 per spin.

What if I run out of credits?

Press Reset credits to go back to 100 anytime.
